about: A website's fonts, how each one is licensed, and the closest free font for each one that is not free.

tools.name: make_font_kit
tools.title: Fonts of a website
tools.asks: the fonts a site uses, their files and licenses, or free fonts that match a site's type
makes: a page's fonts with their licenses
tools.description: Reads one page of a website in a headless browser and saves its fonts in one folder: which font draws its headings, body text, buttons and code, every font file the page loads, how each one is licensed, and the closest free font for each one that is not free. FONTS.md is the file to read first, fonts.css is for pages, with a variable for each role, and fonts.json for tools. The license of each font is written next to it so the user can decide what to use. It reads only the page at url, so a font used only on another page needs a run on that page, and a page that answers with an error gives that error page's fonts. For a whole brand kit with logos and colors, use make_brand_kit instead.

url.description: The page whose fonts to read, like https://linear.app. Only that page is read, and fonts can differ between pages, so give the one whose look is needed.

files.description: Save every font file the page loads in files/ (default {default:make_font_kit.files}). Set to false to read the font files without saving them; fonts.css then loads none of the site's own files.

timeout_seconds.description: Give up after this many seconds (default {default:make_font_kit.timeout_seconds}). When a role shows a system font where the site's own was expected, its fonts may load late: try {fact:easyfontkit.late_timeout}.

done: Tell the user each role's font and its license from the table below, with the closest free font beside any commercial or unknown one, and let them choose.

{name:FONTS.md} below names the address asked even when that page answered with an error, which the kit does not say: when every role is a system font like Times New Roman, check that the page opens before handing the fonts over.
A login page shows as the address it led to.
